criteria.name: artifacts_exist
criteria.description: Every declared artifact exists under /app/out.

criteria.name: negative_unsafe_archive_members
criteria.description: Detects an unsafe file member in patched-repo.zip.

criteria.name: archive_src_layout
criteria.description: patched-repo.zip contains the K1 src layout and visible tests.

criteria.name: api_entry_points_importable
criteria.description: The delivered package exposes every documented entry point from a foreign working directory.

criteria.name: visible_repo_tests_pass_from_archive
criteria.description: The nine visible repository tests pass when run from the extracted patched-repo.zip.

criteria.name: summary_json_matches_delivered_run
criteria.description: summary.json equals the run summary the delivered package produces for the shipped inputs.

criteria.name: module_core_claims_match_archive
criteria.description: module_core.json lists only core functions whose code differs from the shipped repository.

criteria.name: module_parser_claims_match_archive
criteria.description: module_parser.json lists only parser functions whose code differs from the shipped repository.

criteria.name: module_report_claims_match_archive
criteria.description: module_report.json lists only report functions whose code differs from the shipped repository.

criteria.name: test_fixes_matches_visible_test_runs
criteria.description: test_fixes.json records the real before and after result of each visible test.

criteria.name: repair_report_well_formed
criteria.description: repair-report.json names the package, lists fixes and at least one passed check.

criteria.name: signature_keeps_explicit_null
criteria.description: state_signature reports an explicit null field as null, apart from an absent field.

criteria.name: signature_rejects_unknown_schema
criteria.description: state_signature called on an unknown schema id raises E_UNKNOWN_SCHEMA.

criteria.name: plan_revisits_schema_with_new_state
criteria.description: The cheapest plan passes the source schema twice after a state change and the planner returns it.

criteria.name: plan_tie_first_edge_decides
criteria.description: Among equal-cost plans the smallest edge-id list wins even when it has more edges.

criteria.name: ladder_large_state
criteria.description: Forty-five-layer ladder with state-dependent edges is planned within the time limit.

criteria.name: exec_add_fill_absent_vs_null
criteria.description: add fills absent fields, and explicit nulls only where the fill mode allows it.

criteria.name: exec_correction_first_arrival_only
criteria.description: A correction pinned to a schema the plan revisits applies on the first arrival only, so a later has check fails.

criteria.name: identity_merge_chain_followed
criteria.description: resolve_partner follows the merge chain to its final partner.

criteria.name: identity_merge_loop_rejected
criteria.description: resolve_partner rejects a merge loop.

criteria.name: identity_partner_id_beats_alias
criteria.description: resolve_partner gives a partner id precedence over an equal alias.

criteria.name: pipe_rejection_codes
criteria.description: run_pipeline gives each rejected line its catalogue code, including merge loops and state-unreachable lines.

criteria.name: pipe_bad_lines_run_continues
criteria.description: run_pipeline keeps processing after lines that are not JSON and leaves their identity fields null.

criteria.name: receipt_skips_lines_rejected_at_parse
criteria.description: run_pipeline lists the batches whose receipt differs, counting only records that keep their batch.

criteria.name: receipt_counts_partner_rejected_lines
criteria.description: The batch receipt covers lines rejected at the partner stage, whose records keep a null fingerprint.

criteria.name: tokens_match_exactly
criteria.description: run_pipeline turns a payload string into null only when it equals one of the partner's tokens exactly.

criteria.name: summary_categories_code_first
criteria.description: build_summary assigns each record to a category by its code first, in taxonomy order.

criteria.name: summary_partner_order_by_rank
criteria.description: build_summary lists ranked partners by rank, then the unranked ones by id.
